catalog.label: Study the House
catalog.narrativeSetup: You have some free time. You could memorize the layout for competitions, or try something riskier...

approachOptions.label: Memorize the Layout
approachOptions.description: Carefully study the house layout for future competitions
approachOptions.consequencePreview: +1 competition study bonus. Safe and reliable.

approachOptions.label: Sneak a Peek at Production Notes
approachOptions.description: Try to find production hints about upcoming competitions
approachOptions.consequencePreview: +2 study bonus on success, but lose 1 bonus if caught.
